name: Warangal
registryBasis: The official Warangal District government land-records page links to Telangana’s integrated land registry and identifies the local Tahsil/Collectorate. Telangana’s official Bhu Bharati GIS describes parcel-information map interaction; however, no safe public geometry response has been verified at this locator.

queries.query: వరంగల్ భూమి రికార్డులు భూ భారతి కడాస్ట్రల్ పటం అధికారిక సేవలు
queries.scope: Locate Warangal-specific official land records and inspect public cadastral geometry safely.
queries.result: Warangal District government links citizens to Telangana land records; official Bhu Bharati GIS advertises parcel information on map click. TGRAC layer 0 is polygon cadastral boundary with safe survey field Base_Syno, while layer 1 exposes personal farmer fields. A point-only layer-0 query requested FID,Base_Syno and geometry, but the service returned HTTP 400 for unsupported GeoJSON and timed out with its documented JSON response.
queries.executionMethod: Separate language-specific search followed by official-source/service review. Only anonymous public technical tests were attempted where safe.

queries.scope: Locate Warangal-specific official land records and inspect public cadastral geometry safely.
queries.result: The official state GIS metadata shows a regional polygon cadastral layer whose extent covers the point. The bounded exact-point geometry attempt did not return feature data. No owner/farmer attributes were requested, and the separate personal-data point layer was not queried.
queries.executionMethod: Separate language-specific search followed by official-source/service review. Only anonymous public technical tests were attempted where safe.

scopeLimits: Layer 0 metadata shows polygon features with a Base_Syno survey-number field and service extent covering the locator. A single exact-point query limited to FID,Base_Syno and geometry returned HTTP 400 for unsupported GeoJSON output; the equivalent documented JSON query timed out. The separate dharani_data layer exposes FarmerName and MobileNo fields and was not queried. No parcel geometry or feature identifier was retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
